title: pi-serena-lsp Tool Contracts
description: Shared JSON contract defining parameters for all 7 Serena LSP tools exposed to the Pi coding agent. This file is the single source of truth for parameter types, required fields, and descriptions across the TypeScript and Python sides.

get_symbols_overview.description: Get a Serena top-level symbol overview for a source file.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

find_symbol.description: Search Serena's LSP symbol index by name path pattern (component-by-component, right-to-left match).

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path pattern. Matched component-by-component, right-to-left, each component exact. Use leading / for absolute (exact full) match.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

code_snippet.description: Exact source code snippet to scope the search via rg. Only symbols whose location falls within a snippet occurrence are returned.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of symbol matches to return. Default 10. -1 means unlimited.

get_symbol_from_snippet.description: Resolve a concrete source occurrence to Serena-style symbol references.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

code_snippet.description: Exact source code snippet containing the symbol occurrence to resolve. Prefer enough surrounding code to make it unique.

symbol_text.description: Exact symbol text inside code_snippet where the LSP cursor should be placed.

line.description: Optional 1-based line filter. Only snippet occurrences spanning this line are considered.

column.description: Optional 1-based column filter. Requires line; only occurrences whose symbol_text covers this column are considered.

find_referencing_symbols.description: Find symbols that reference a given Serena symbol.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

find_declaration.description: Resolve the declaration/definition for a Serena symbol using Serena's LSP backend.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

find_implementations.description: Find implementations for a symbol using Serena's LSP backend when the active language server supports it.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

rename_symbol.description: Rename a symbol throughout the project using Serena's LSP refactoring.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

new_name.description: New symbol name. The language server may reject rename if the workspace has errors.
